summary: Master Odoo ERP with our specialized training course focused on customization and module development. Elevate your expertise and career prospects!
lede: Odoo ERP customization and module development combines ORM models, PostgreSQL data persistence, XML views, Python business logic, access controls, QWeb reporting, and Git-based deployment. This course turns those capabilities into a repeatable lifecycle for building structured add-ons that protect data integrity, usability, security, and upgrade readiness. You will create manifests, extend models, build interfaces, define permissions and record rules, implement workflow logic, produce reports, and validate tests through a guided development project. Hands-on work also covers diagnostics with Visual Studio Code and browser developer tools, while OWL customization, integrations, Docker, continuous integration, and AI-assisted suggestions receive focused conceptual or operational coverage.
audienceIntro: This Odoo ERP training course is designed for technical and implementation professionals who need to convert business requirements into secure, maintainable Odoo extensions. It suits learners progressing from foundational add-on concepts toward intermediate development tasks.
modules: Odoo QWeb Reports and OWL Extensions
Odoo Testing Deployment and Upgrade Readiness
prerequisites: Programming requirement: Coding is required. You will write basic Python, XML, CSV, and QWeb template code, while OWL and integration engineering remain at conceptual or operational application depth. Equipment: Bring a laptop with administrative installation rights where possible. The delivery team will provide setup guidance for Odoo Community Edition, PostgreSQL, Python, Git, Visual Studio Code, and the course dataset.
